internal.name: internal corpus
internal.population: Named Windows operators. Minimum: the person who produced the tagged NSIS artifact plus one other operator, or a recorded solo-operator exception.

beta.population: Named opt-in testers recorded in the promotion record. Not a percentage of users and not an anonymous cohort.
beta.feedback: Written notes after the interval. Optional Help → Export Diagnostics, user-reviewed; no automatic upload.
exitCriteria: feedbackIntervalDays elapsed with a written report from each of minimumTesters
no missing recovery on crash/restart of accepted fixtures
no critical or high security defect
tagged NSIS install/update succeeds on a non-admin account
compatibility fixtures still pass on the promoted commit
explicit gate review recorded for this version

requires: internal corpus and fault tests recorded
GitHub Release unmarked as prerelease only after sign-off

preserve: diagnostic ring until the user exports or uninstalls with Delete application data
halt.diagnostics: Help → Export Diagnostics only after confirmation. No automatic upload.

withdraw.github: draft the GitHub Release and keep it a prerelease. Do not delete the git tag, SHA256SUMS.txt, or provenance.json.
withdraw.notify: Named testers recorded on the promotion record. There is no auto-update to pull the build back.
withdraw.offerPrior: Last installer in verified-installers.json that is not the withdrawn version. Empty list means none to offer.
forbidden: uninstall with Delete the application data
